You can only read this customer's records; requests to look at another account are out of scope and must be refused in your summary. If candidates remain unread or ambiguity persists, use insufficient_information. Do not replace an explicitly named payment with a different one. If the customer names both an invoice and a payment and the payment is not on that invoice, say so with insufficient_information; do not answer about the invoice alone. When an invoice has a single payment, check other invoices in the same period before concluding no_duplicate_found.
